surrounding.trailing:
The Door step banking service can be offered by the bank through any of the following means.
By Banks own regular staff
Outsourcing the operations to a Cash management vendor who have national / regional presence with a good track record. The outsourcing to such vendor will be governed by the outsourcing policy of the bank.
Through banking correspondents empaneled with the bank.
Services provided through outsourcing or through banking correspondents will be through a mutually signed agreement detailing the terms and conditions including charges for executing these services, turnaround time.

llm_analyze_result.description: This table outlines the savings limits per instance for different types of banking services offered to various customer categories. The rows represent types of services, specifically 'Cash Pickup' and 'Cash Delivery'. The columns delineate the specific savings limits applicable to three distinct customer categories: 'Savings (individuals)', 'Senior Citizen / Differently Abled', and 'Current Account Customers'. Each service allows individuals and senior citizens/differently abled customers to save up to 20,000 per instance, while current account customers have a significantly higher limit of 5 lacs per instance. Notably, the distinction in savings limits highlights the banks' approach to meet different needs across customer segments. The values are presented clearly, with all monetary amounts expressed as per instance, and the note at the bottom indicates that savings limits are subject to change per bank policy. This table serves as a guideline for customers to understand the limits connected to their specific service type and demographic category.
